title: Authority Closers onboarding/profile taxonomy v1
description: Contract-only shape for optional, user-declared onboarding/profile attributes. It is not an authorization, entitlement, consent, score, or recommendation schema.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. The current requested-country configuration allows IN; the source manifest owns the allowlist. Do not infer from IP, locale, provider, or phone prefix.

phone_number_e164.description: User-declared direct phone endpoint in canonical E.164 presentation. A matching number is allowed but phone and WhatsApp remain separate fields.

whatsapp_number_e164.description: User-declared WhatsApp endpoint in canonical E.164 presentation. It is not proof of WhatsApp availability, verification, opt-in, or provider delivery.

education_level_code.description: Broad ISCED 2011 attainment-level reference. This does not assert local degree equivalence, recognition, eligibility, or competency.

degree_name.description: Optional exact user-entered name of a degree, diploma, certificate, or other qualification. Do not normalize abbreviations or infer equivalence.

education_field_code.description: Broad ISCED-F 2013 field reference. Do not infer it from degree or specialization; NOT_STATED is a valid answer.

specialization.description: Optional exact user-entered specialization or concentration. It is descriptive text, not a verified qualification or controlled equivalence.

sales_interest_codes.description: Optional user-selected AC-owned learning-interest labels. The set is descriptive only and has no score, access, ranking, or automatic personalization effect.

sales_interest_other.description: Optional user-entered sales-learning interest, required only when sales_interest_codes contains other.
